en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone fortification wall or tower along a narrow street. The left side shows a tall masonry structure with small windows and iron bars; people, including children, walk along the street below. On the right are more modern masonry buildings and a stone wall, with leafed trees in the background. At the bottom margin, there is printed caption text.
